verdict.rationale: Khoj's telemetry docs say users can opt out at any time by setting the KHOJ_TELEMETRY_DISABLE environment variable to True. The local-only deployment notes support a privacy-first posture. One HN user (likely on an older release) said the PostHog telemetry was undocumented with no clear opt-out; that is a discoverability complaint, not a hands-on failure of the documented switch. Missing for 10: documentation of what telemetry collects, an opt-out path for Khoj Cloud or UI users beyond a server env var, and independent confirmation that the flag stops tracking.
